section_summary.extract_value: This section details the direct relationships between ability, learning orientation, and performance orientation with various learning outcomes. It reports that ability was positively related to most learning outcomes. Learning orientation was positively related to self-efficacy (beta = .24), performance (beta = .14), and knowledge (beta = .19). Performance orientation had a significant negative relationship only with task performance (beta = -.12), otherwise showing no significant relationship with self-efficacy or knowledge. The findings are stated to be consistent with prior research.
